latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker AI YouTube — Create and Export YouTube Videos.

- Upload video clips or images and generate 1080p MP4 files ready for YouTube using AI.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; typical processing time is 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session and token management with up to 100 free credits for new users.
- Includes easy commands for uploading, editing, exporting, credit checking, and session status.
- Provides clear error handling, platform compatibility, and user-friendly status updates.
